pages.contents: One landscape page headed CARE Checklist of information to include when writing a case report, with the CARE logo at the upper left, a tick mark at the upper right and a CC BY-NC-ND badge near the top. A red-headed table lists Topic, Item and Checklist item description rows 1 to 13 (title, key words, abstract 3a to 3d, introduction, patient information 5a to 5d, clinical findings, timeline, diagnostic assessment 8a to 8d, therapeutic intervention 9a to 9c, follow-up and outcomes 10a to 10d, discussion 11a to 11d, patient perspective, informed consent). The Reported on Line column holds Yes with manuscript line numbers for most items and NA for items 5d, 7, 8b, 9c, 10b and 12; item 13 reads Yes.
pages.clinical_relevance_notes: Administrative reporting checklist with manuscript line references and a consent answer. It contains no individual history, test results, measurements, doses, treatment course or outcomes. NA cells are not patient clinical negatives. No clinical-schema facts are generated from this page.

limitations: Administrative manuscript-reference information does not constitute additional patient clinical data.
Document inspection is an AI source review, not physician adjudication or a measurement of clinical accuracy. The printed BY-NC-ND notice remains separate from the main article license.
